question.hypothesis: AREG's contribution to a fibroblast response is set by where the ligand is released relative to a competent recipient, not by which compartment transcribes the most of it.
question.leg_1: Where an epithelial source and a fibroblast are in contact, removing the epithelial ligand lowers a frozen fibroblast TGF-beta response programme, while removing the epithelium's own receptors does not.
question.leg_2: Across donors, the fibroblast response tracks the recipient's own TGF-beta activation machinery more closely than it tracks epithelial ligand abundance.
inherits: docs/NEXT_DATASET_GATE.md, for the GSE307112 joins and prohibitions

why_the_previous_framing_is_closed.superseded_question: Which compartment is the dominant AREG source, and does that dominance change with context.

record.C37: epithelial over myeloid detection in ten donors on deposited labels, six of ten at the primary 1,000-UMI budget; descriptive only
record.C39: CD1c-positive dendritic cells above both tumour epithelial states; not established, and it qualifies C37
record.C45: dendritic cells and monocytes at or above epithelial states in two diseases; descriptive only
record.C40: AREG not enriched in tumour against matched normal lung; refuted at compartment level
record.C48: neither AREG nor HBEGF rising with fibrosis against control; not established
record.C49: epithelial AREG against fibroblast EGFR across 22 donors, rho 0.348, p 0.112; not established
record.C50: epithelial AREG against a fibroblast activation score, rho -0.150; not established
record.C51: the only significant correlation in that trial was a depth-tracking control pair, refused by a frozen rule; validated as a decision record

why_the_previous_framing_is_closed.reading: Total ligand abundance is not the rate-limiting quantity the mechanism uses, so the abundance comparisons measured the wrong observable. This reframing commits the question to a different observable that can fail; it does not re-grade any row above.

mechanism_sources.role: amphiregulin activates integrin alphaV on mesenchymal stromal cells, releasing bioactive TGF-beta and driving myofibroblast differentiation; macrophages a critical source
amphiregulin silencing or EGFR inhibition reduces TGF-beta1-driven fibroblast proliferation, smooth-muscle actin and collagen
regulatory T cell amphiregulin is non-redundant for lung tissue protection, independent of suppressor function and viral load
type 2 innate lymphoid cells drive lung fibroblast proliferation and differentiation partly through amphiregulin and EGFR
both epithelial and leukocyte amphiregulin sources are established; the constraint on an epithelium-only reading, already reference M4

dataset.design: CRISPR knockout in mouse alveolar type 2 cells co-cultured with unedited human lung fibroblasts; per-well RNA with reads assigned by species
dataset.why_it_separates_the_rivals: The perturbation is epithelial only and the fibroblasts are unedited, so removing the ligand removes what the fibroblast can receive while removing epithelial receptors removes only epithelial reception.

source_paper.rule: use the deposit, not the paper's claims; write no study note; the precedent is DEVELOPMENT decision 21

layout_computed_from_the_cached_qc_table.note: Computed in session from cache/GSE307112_xenome_stats.csv.gz; stage 1 must recompute it with a run record and may contradict it.

hbegf_location.consequence: the ligand-specificity contrast crosses plates and is secondary and weaker

knockout_validation.units: difference in mean log2 CPM of the targeted mouse transcript, targeted libraries against pooled other libraries
knockout_validation.why_not_recorded: A10 tested only genes that were also members of its declared module set.
knockout_validation.stage_1_action: extract the Erbb2 and Erbb4 mouse rows and report them on the same footing
knockout_validation.partial_perturbation: Areg falls by 1.042 log2 CPM and remains at 6.226, so the knockout is partial and pooled; a null is inconclusive by design
knockout_validation.unvalidated_rule: a target whose transcript does not fall is treated as unvalidated; the recorded Il1a case rose by 0.398

unit.independence: unresolved; A10 stage 1 could not establish separate epithelial isolations or fibroblast lots, so every result here is a within-screen association

primary.name: HALLMARK_TGF_BETA_SIGNALING
primary.why: mechanism-matched: the recorded action of amphiregulin on mesenchymal cells is TGF-beta activation
primary.recorded_coverage_in_this_screen: 54 of 54 members assayed on the human side, from the A10 hallmark coverage table

co_primary_confirmatory.name: fibroblast activation score
co_primary_confirmatory.source: frozen for trial E6 in Research Article/gate2_05_cardoso_2026; the score behind C50 and the C51 depth precedent
co_primary_confirmatory.why: the differentiation endpoint the mechanism predicts, already frozen in this repository for a different dataset

endpoints.scoring: mean log2 CPM over the set's members present in the human index, prior count 1, with the well's own human total as the denominator
prohibited: modifying, re-weighting or swapping either endpoint after any value is seen
adding a block of Hallmark sets, which would enlarge the multiplicity family
defining an endpoint from this screen's own expression

adjustment.method: within each unit, regress the endpoint on the covariates across that unit's wells and use the residual
adjustment.why: C51 established that a depth control is load-bearing in this repository; composition shifts bulk expression on both sides
adjustment.unadjusted_score: reported as a sensitivity, never as the primary

statistic.definition: within each unit, the rank of the Areg well's residual among all wells of that unit; the four ranks combined by their sum
statistic.null: exact, from the uniform rank distribution under the hypothesis that the Areg knockout has no specific effect on the endpoint
statistic.direction: one-sided lower, declared before any value is read
statistic.reference_wells: all other libraries in the unit supply the empirical reference; the two control wells anchor the unperturbed location
statistic.stated_assumption: this is a randomization-style comparison against the unit's own perturbations, so it asks whether the Areg well is exceptional among perturbations rather than against an unperturbed population; it is conservative when other wells act on the same pathway

threshold.consistency_requirement: the Areg well below its unit median in at least 3 of the 4 units

predictions.delivery_hypothesis: Areg lower; the receptor knockouts not systematically lower; Itgb6 not required to be lower because the activating integrin is placed on the recipient
predictions.autocrine_rival: the receptor knockouts move with, or instead of, Areg
predictions.epithelial_activation_rival: Itgb6 moves as much as Areg
predictions.ligand_specificity: Hbegf weaker or absent; this contrast crosses plates and is labelled weaker

decision_rules.supported: the primary clears its threshold and its consistency requirement, the co-primary agrees in direction, and the receptor contrasts do not show the same shift; the reading is a within-screen descriptive association
decision_rules.inconclusive: any other outcome, including a primary that clears while the co-primary contradicts it, and including a shift that the covariate sensitivity removes
decision_rules.precise_absence: unavailable at this design; four units and a partial knockout cannot bound the effect, and no bound will be reported as absence
decision_rules.descriptive_only: always, while preparation independence is unresolved

assumptions_carried: the mouse ligand acts on the human receptor; stage 1 attempts a sequence-level check of the amphiregulin EGF-like domain and records the assumption as carried if it cannot be run
species read assignment identifies the compartment of origin, established in A10 from data rather than from sheet names

dataset.why_reused: trial E6 tested the abundance version here and found nothing; the instrument is frozen and the estimand is new

instrument_reused_unchanged_from_e6.donors: Subject_Identity, restricted to Disease_Identity in IPF and Control; COPD out of scope
instrument_reused_unchanged_from_e6.fibroblasts: Manuscript_Identity in Fibroblast and Myofibroblast; mural cells excluded
instrument_reused_unchanged_from_e6.depth_measure: median deposited genes per cell, per donor and compartment
instrument_reused_unchanged_from_e6.measure: fraction of cells with a non-zero count

leg_2.new_estimand: whether the fibroblast activation score tracks the recipient's own TGF-beta activation machinery, measured in the same fibroblasts, more closely than it tracks epithelial AREG detection

controls_not_optional.depth_rule: the C51 rule unchanged: if both members of a pair correlate with their own compartment depth at absolute rho of 0.4 or more, the pair is reported as confounded and is not read

shared_detection_control.rule: scored the same way in the same fibroblasts; if the machinery correlation is no stronger than this control's correlation with the activation score, the result is attributed to shared detection and is not read

controls_not_optional.disease_stratum: the IPF-only stratum reported next to the pooled result

declared_reading.supported_observationally: machinery predicts activation where ligand abundance did not, and the depth rule does not refuse the pair; still correlational, with no direction and no proximity
declared_reading.not_visible: neither predicts; the report states the smallest effect the donor count could have detected
declared_reading.refused: the depth rule or the shared-detection control refuses the pair; this refusal is the result and is reported as one

prohibited_readings: Any claim about proximity, distance or gradient from a single-well co-culture.
Any secreted-protein or receptor-engagement claim; C36 stays Not established.
A receptor-knockout shift read as fibroblast causation.
Wells, guides or organoids as biological replicates.
Re-grading C37, C49 or C50, or adding a claim row; grading is the owner's decision.
A study note on the screen's source paper, whose owner reading is pending.
Reinterpreting A10's fits, or using A10's growth outcome as evidence for this question.
Substituting an alternative endpoint or depth budget for the declared one as though it were independent confirmation.
